title: List grid: an undo pressed the moment a reload lands can paint the row from the previous load (loadedRowsRef mirrored in an effect)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Follow-up from PR #36064 (#35999), recorded by its L1-a review (ACCEPT 7062696900) as an observation, not a change that PR owes. Under epic #35683.

## What happens

`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (around lines 1707-1710 on `1ed9d921`) mirrors the loaded rows into `loadedRowsRef` in an effect with no dependency list, and `currentRowOf` reads that ref. If a reload has painted but that render's effect has not run yet, an undo in that window rebases on the previous load's row. The screen shows the older row until the next load. The server data is right. It is the same class of race #35999 fixed for `rowPatchesRef`, with a narrower window (one render) and a display-only effect.

## To do

Write `loadedRowsRef` where the loaded rows are set, not in a passive effect, as #36064 did for the patch table, and pin it the same deterministic way (act the moment the new load's row reaches the DOM). If reading on main shows the window cannot be reached by a user, say so on this card and close it.

## Acceptance

- An undo pressed in the render after a reload lands reads the new load's row, pinned, red with the fix removed.
